## `project_attribute`

*Available in [Python](#project_attribute-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Decorator used for CIDA project getter functions.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    project_attribute(
        f
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `f` (`<Unspecified>`) - The function to be wrapped.

    <h4>Returns `<Unspecified>`</h4>
